## Purpose and Runtime Shape
AzuraCast is a self-hosted Internet-radio management suite. It combines a PHP backend, Vue frontend, station audio services, and operational dependencies into Dockerized deployment units. The public HTTP entry point is `web/index.php`; CLI administration, installation, queue processing, and synchronization enter through `backend/bin/console` and `backend/bin/installer`.

## HTTP Application and API Boundary
The backend constructs an application/container and routes requests through HTTP middleware, authentication, authorization, and controllers. Route families deliberately separate administrator, authenticated frontend, station-scoped, public, and internal service APIs.
- `backend/src/AppFactory.php`
- `backend/config/routes.php`
- `backend/config/routes/api_station.php`
- `backend/src/Middleware/Auth/ApiAuth.php`
- `backend/src/Controller/Api/Internal/LiquidsoapAction.php`

Frontend-rendered pages and API-driven Vue pages coexist: PHP serves templates/global props while Vite-built Vue components provide management, station, and public player interfaces.
- `backend/src/View.php`
- `backend/templates/system/vue_page.phtml`
- `frontend/components/Stations/StationsLayout.vue`

## Persistent Domain and Storage
Doctrine entities model multi-station configuration and operational state: stations, media, playlists/groups/queues, stream mounts, streamers, listeners, podcasts, requests, webhooks, and audit records. Repository classes encapsulate station-aware data access. Media and assets are abstracted behind Flysystem, allowing local, S3, Dropbox, or SFTP-backed storage.
- `backend/src/Entity/Station.php`
- `backend/src/Entity/StationPlaylist.php`
- `backend/src/Entity/StationQueue.php`
- `backend/src/Entity/Repository/StationRepository.php`
- `backend/src/Flysystem/StationFilesystems.php`
- `backend/src/Entity/StorageLocationAdapter/S3StorageLocationAdapter.php`

MariaDB is the primary relational database, with schema evolution in the extensive migration set.
- `backend/src/Doctrine/Platform/MariaDbPlatform.php`
- `backend/src/Entity/Migration/AbstractMigration.php`
- `util/docker/mariadb/mariadb/db.cnf.tmpl`

## Radio Control Plane and Audio Pipeline
Station configuration is translated into runtime configuration for radio backends/frontends. AutoDJ scheduling builds queues from media, playlist rules, requests, duplicate prevention, and interrupting tracks; Liquidsoap consumes generated configuration/playlist files to produce streams. Icecast, Shoutcast, and RSAS are supported frontend adapters; remote relay adapters integrate external streams.
- `backend/src/Radio/AutoDJ/QueueBuilder.php`
- `backend/src/Radio/AutoDJ/Scheduler.php`
- `backend/src/Radio/Backend/Liquidsoap/ConfigWriter.php`
- `backend/src/Radio/Frontend/Icecast.php`
- `backend/src/Radio/Remote/AzuraRelay.php`

The packaged station runtime includes Liquidsoap, Icecast, FFmpeg, and audio-processing dependencies.
- `util/docker/stations/liquidsoap/azuracast.liq`
- `util/docker/stations/setup/liquidsoap.sh`
- `util/docker/stations/setup/icecast.sh`

## Async Work, Synchronization, and Realtime State
Long-running work is decoupled through message queues: media ingestion/reprocessing, cover art, backups, playlist-file generation, ACME certificates, and webhook delivery. Scheduled sync tasks maintain media/playlist state, queues, listener analytics, cleanup, backups, and certificates. Now-playing data is periodically generated and cached for public/API consumption; Centrifugo is provisioned for realtime delivery.
- `backend/config/messagequeue.php`
- `backend/src/MessageQueue/QueueManager.php`
- `backend/src/Sync/NowPlaying/Task/NowPlayingTask.php`
- `backend/src/Sync/Task/RunAnalyticsTask.php`
- `backend/src/Cache/NowPlayingCache.php`
- `backend/src/Service/Centrifugo.php`

Redis is an infrastructure dependency for caching/queue-related services.
- `backend/src/Service/RedisFactory.php`
- `util/docker/redis/redis/redis.conf`

## External Integrations and Operations
The system integrates object storage and SFTP, album-art metadata providers, GeoIP sources, ACME, outbound mail, and a broad webhook connector set. Nginx configuration is generated around station/public streaming requirements; Supervisor runs web, workers, now-playing jobs, and service processes. Docker Compose and image scripts define the deployable topology.
- `backend/src/Media/AlbumArtHandler/LastFmAlbumArtHandler.php`
- `backend/src/Service/IpGeolocator/GeoLite.php`
- `backend/src/Webhook/Dispatcher.php`
- `backend/src/Nginx/ConfigWriter.php`
- `util/docker/web/service.full/php-worker.conf`
- `docker-compose.sample.yml`
